label: Epic Richter AI
summary: Below 15% HP, Richter waits for Alucard to land and grabs him with the real Stopwatch item crash: four staggered clocks with their waves, each ending in lightning. He keeps his current side, stops four tiles away or at the room edge, then holds his Up stance and laughs for one second before firing 10 HP daggers. The last clock completes its five-second countdown before releasing Alucard and starting Hydrostorm. Richter is immune to Stopwatch slowdown. In the aggressive phase below 25% HP, he crouches for one second with his hurt grunt after each Cross, Bible or Agunea crash.

notes: Exact AI edits = bytes changed by the chain 'Richter Boss AI v3 diff (ASS 2.0).ppf' then v4..v9 '(ASS 2.0, over vN)' (all with undo data; each PPF's old bytes match the previous state exactly), minus bytes the PPFs merely rewrote with unchanged values: 4334 bytes in 5 regions. a matches the v9 build blobs byte for byte (out/ai_thinking.bin, ai_checksubwpn.bin, ai_dbgfree.bin, ai_jtfree.bin + slot value, from scratch-workspaces/.../scratch-2026-09-29-7ca40b/richter-ai-patch, source ric_ai.c, update_bin.py). off = o = vanilla at every edited byte. BO6 o->a = 4423 bytes = AI 4334 + Richter-Boss-Room tiles 56 (0x1F7A0..) + Richter-Stats 10 (subweapons_def 0x12E0/0x136C/0x14C0/0x1510) + Richter-Save 4 (0x353DC) + No Flinch 1 (0x3548E) + MP&Hearts 4 (0xF18/0x34114/0x34644) + Alucard-Rebalance 1 (0x34BD9) + Reawakened damage colours 13 (0xACC/0x2A934/0x2B514); none of these overlap the AI edits, so toggling the AI keeps all of them. Caution: the v7-v9 PPFs rewrite whole sectors 2 and 77, so the v9 PPF also carries the Richter-Stats subweapons_def values; never toggle by applying/undoing the raw PPFs - use these edits. Vanilla comparison: 'Richter Boss AI v3 (SotN USA).ppf' on vanilla equals 'v3 diff (ASS 2.0)' on o in every AI byte (they differ only where vanilla and 1.3.1 already differ, outside the AI), and v4..v9 apply cleanly on top of it. Dependencies checked: jal targets are AI code, vanilla BO6 func_us_801B5A14 / RicSetInvincibilityFrames / RicCreateEntFactoryFromEntity / RicEntityCrashBibleBeam, and main-exe rand; data refs are vanilla BO6 state/bss, subweapons_def, game RAM (g_Player, g_Entities, g_Timer) and g_api.enemyDefs[0x13A] (exists in vanilla: atk 35; ASS: 360). Richter-Save sends lethal damage into the step-0x70 cutscene route; the AI keeps vanilla's 'D_us_801D169C -> think step 0x28' hand-off. Vanilla tip: writing 0000 into the four non-zero arms[].attack tunables makes those entities use the Cross enemy def's attack (35 on vanilla), which is how v2/v3 (SotN USA) behaved. Tunables = arms[] damage values and the 41 decision-table weights; distance thresholds/timers are code immediates and are not marked. Not emulator-verified here.
revisionNotes: ASS 2.0.06: on bytes refreshed from current BIN SHA-256 C9BC93E79704F3C136EF202609B912C31B805CF07EE5174C8EFE896B1EAEA2F3; earlier AI bytes remain onAlt. Added instruction at BO6 0x3622C was zero in vanilla, ASS 1.3.1 and earlier AI builds. No other feature bytes included. Gameplay not verified here. Clock finisher: exact BO6 code from the current image; earlier AI entry bytes remain recognized. Complete earlier AI versions remain recognizable with their tuning masks; finisher code and all hooks are guarded in full. Only this dagger stream bypasses normal damage handling. Fresh-boot gameplay remains unverified. Grounded revision: waits without locking Alucard or spending the timer until both characters are grounded and Alucard has no vertical speed. Removes grab gravity; Richter gains native Stopwatch immunity and stops on Alucard's facing side with a 16-pixel hitbox gap. The previous finisher remains recognized with tuned weights. Crash recovery revision: EntityRichter now calls a wrapper (0x801CF278 and 0x801CF354, unreferenced zero BSS) that runs the AI, latches a forced Cross/Bible/Agunea crash in aggressive mode below 25% HP, then holds Down for 60 frames with sound 0x83A once Richter is on his feet, keeping the AI in think step 0. Hits, death, cutscenes, scripted think steps and the finisher cancel it. The four-clock finisher without it remains recognized. Real Stopwatch crash revision: entity 0x39 spawns four BP 0x3F clocks 17 frames apart, crash clocks chain behind each other, keep the time stop and Alucard held until the last one ends, and each ends with player Richter's Stopwatch crash sparkle and lightning (entity 0x2E, no hitbox). The code replaces the thrown Agunea and Vibhuti crash code, which boss Richter never runs. The four-clock visual is cleared; the previous finisher remains recognized. Dagger pause revision: the Up stance before the dagger crash lasts 60 frames (tunable), so the four clocks and their waves finish first.
